verdict.rationale: The evidence shows VLP advises clients on launching AI products, which is a regulatory practice area, not a disclosure of how the firm itself uses AI in client service. The 'high-efficiency workflow' virtual practice model never mentions AI. No named tools, AI-use policies, or firm-built AI products are evidenced, and llms.txt returns 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the firm publishes how it uses AI in client service — named tools, policies, or AI-practice products of its own — beyond a marketing mention
